title: Content overlay manifest
description: overlay.json at the root of a content overlay, read by RefurbishedDinosaurs.Core's ContentOverlay. The payload for each file is files/<path> in the same zip archive or directory.

name.description: The overlay's identifier, recorded as the conversion method of every installed file it writes.

fromVersion.description: The content version the overlay applies to.

toVersion.description: The content version once it is applied.

files.description: Paths are unique ignoring case, and no path is a directory of another.

path.description: The target relative to the content root, a path PortableAssetPath.Relative accepts.

baseXxh3.description: The XXH3-128 the target must have before it is replaced, or null when the file is added and must not exist.

xxh3.description: The XXH3-128 of the payload. It differs from baseXxh3.
